subject.title: feat(workboard): review gate hard blocks + workboard_submit_review tool

question: Should Workboard accept a durable `ready_to_merge` review lifecycle with a model-facing `workboard_submit_review` tool, or should review enforcement stay on the existing statuses/tools?
rationale: The PR changes stored Workboard state and fail-closed completion behavior, so the code defects are repairable only after maintainers accept the lifecycle direction.

options.title: Repair this review lifecycle
options.body: Accept the new lifecycle direction but require the completion gate, response envelope, tool declarations, status consumers, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid the new stored status
options.body: Redesign the gate around existing `review` and `done` states if maintainers do not want `ready_to_merge` as durable Workboard state.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Leave the PR open for author proof and maintainer direction, but do not treat it as mergeable until the lifecycle choice is made.

recommendation.title: Repair this review lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept the new lifecycle direction but require the completion gate, response envelope, tool declarations, status consumers, tests, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The file history shows steipete introduced the Workboard tool, status, plugin-contract, and orchestration surfaces that define this lifecycle.
